instruction.text: Read the text and select true or false for the following statements.

atoms.text: Ads is an abbreviation for advertisements. There are ads everywhere on the internet: on websites, in videos, in games and apps.

atoms.a: Ads are only for informing people.

feedback.end: Ads do inform people, but above all they aim to make people buy certain products or pay for services.

atoms.a: Ads present products in an especially appealing way.

feedback.end: Ads strongly emphasise the advantages and strengths of a product.

atoms.a: Ads are always honest and tell the truth about a product.

feedback.end: Ads often exaggerate and distort the truth.

atoms.text:
Ads can show as a banner on a website.
Select the ad banner.

Ads can also show up in an additional window. These are called pop-up ads.
Select the pop-up.

You have to close the ad to be able to use the actual website.
Close the ad by selecting the X.
Now you can use the website without ads.

atoms.a: What other types of ads are there on the internet? Select the four correct answers.
How can you deal with ads on the internet? Select the three correct answers.
